t2.thesis: SNAP enters earnings with a depressed price, a 13.8% implied move and mixed prior reactions, so the base-rate edge is offset by a lack of directional information.
reasons: Base rates of about 54% apply, and nothing in the dossier gives a clear directional edge
Stock is down 28% over 12 months and 8% over 5 days, which is depressed sentiment with low expectations (forward P/E 7)
Last 4 earnings reactions were 2 up and 2 down despite EPS beats every time, so beats are not rewarded reliably
Implied move of 13.8% and ATM IV of 3x realized vol price in a big move, so there is no mispricing signal
Overhang from legal settlements and CBO departure is already known, and the competitor Reddit fell sharply on its print
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 revenue guidance and DAU/user growth trend (North America DAU declines), with free cash flow progress.

prior.from: I3 overall validation t0_hit 0.542; AMC 0.538; software_internet 0.541; consumer 0.555

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. That earnings date is after today's date (2026-11-03) and beyond my knowledge, so I have no information on how SNAP's stock moved afterward.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down about 4 points from 0.54. Weak sector read-through from Reddit's -25% drop and AMC entry-to-open gap risk offset the depressed-sentiment bounce potential. The result is near-coin-flip.

theses.expected: Rise: guidance in line or better, margin and FCF expansion, low bar.
theses.mechanism: Depressed price and short interest of 7.5% allow a squeeze on a steady print.
theses.wrong_if: Q4 revenue guide is below consensus or DAU declines further.

theses.expected: Fall: weak ad demand and user metrics disappoint.
theses.mechanism: Competition and platform changes slow revenue growth, as flagged in the 10-Q.
theses.wrong_if: Revenue growth holds near 19% with a firm guide.

theses.expected: Flat or choppy open: the large move is partly faded at the open.
theses.mechanism: The 13.8% implied move overprices the reaction and the stock stays near $5.5.
theses.wrong_if: A gap of more than 10% in either direction.

key_observations: Q4 revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance versus consensus
North America and global DAU trend
Free cash flow and cost discipline
ARPU growth and direct revenue business
Commentary on legal settlements and the CBO transition
t2.method: D004 v4: leak-probe call without the dossier, then one decision call on the frozen dossier; no tools
